paper_title: Similar event-related potentials to music and language: A replication of Patel, Gibson, Ratner, Besson, & Holcomb (1998)
authors: de Leeuw, J. R., Andrews, J., Altman, Z., et al.
paper_type: Original empirical article (ERP replication study; NOT a methods/software paper). Task header label 'jsPsych...' is incorrect - jsPsych (de Leeuw 2015) is only a Methods citation.
engine: anomalyco/opencode (ReproAI) - DeepSeek V4 Flash via uniGPT

data.processed_eeg: data/generated/eeg_data_tidy.csv (2,002,000 rows, averaged waveforms, analytic N=35)

scope_limits: Processed (post-artifact-rejection) EEG data analyzed, not raw .fdt recordings; NetStation pre-processing not re-run.
Bayes factors are Monte-Carlo estimates; verified within stated +/-2% MC error.
Figures 1-3 (raster waveforms) and the O1/O2 visual claim not pixel-verified (no vision input).
